recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-32552 unless the work group later chooses to refresh external UDI references as a separate maintenance decision.
issue_request: FHIR-32552 was a Published FHIR-core Device change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that readers not be assumed to know Unique Device Identifier (UDI) and requesting a URL/reference plus usage notes or rationale. The approved resolution changed the Device introduction to name Unique Device Identifier (UDI) and direct readers to the Device UDI section for additional information.
initial_application: Jira records application in commit 473784149376f689f914b2153a980e430918ab1c. That commit changed source/device/device-introduction.xml from an embedded linked phrase to the approved two-sentence clarification. Later Device scope rewrite commit 3c23148747a7d0fead21ff9afaab2fc3bb65eae9 preserved the UDI clarification with an added jurisdiction-timing qualifier, and d382fc3af52ab7607c6c8fead1f47cdf09be3562 converted the UDI target to local device.html#udi.
additional_context: Device is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. The current source/device/device-introduction.xml names Unique Device Identifier (UDI), explains that Device may document it when appropriate or necessary according to local jurisdictions over time, and links to the Unique Device Identifier section. The current source/device/device-notes.xml UDI section includes the external IMDRF UDI System specification link, FDA implementation guide link, UDI carrier/DI/PI explanation, jurisdictional repository/GUDID context, and best-practice transmission guidance. Direct Zulip search found no conflicting FHIR-32552 discussion; Confluence references found OO minutes pages around the 2021 block-vote trail but no conflicting source instruction.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active source already satisfies the Jira-approved clarification and the linked notes section provides the requested standard reference and explanatory context. Additional introductory prose would duplicate maintained notes without changing implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: A later Device scope rewrite commit listed FHIR-32382 among the included changes and preserved the UDI clarification; it was context only, not separately decided.
